text:
maria (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we're rolling out the new e-card recognition called 'Spark' next Wed. Goal: lightweight peer kudos via email + optional physical thank-you for top picks. Need to lock timing, asset sizes, and how we track redemptions. Thoughts? :tada:

alex (Design): Love it. I can ship assets. Suggested formats: PNG + animated GIF for hero. Sizes: 600x400 (email), 1200x630 (social preview). Figma file will be ready by EOD. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/spark-e-cards

chris (Logistics): For physical thank-yous, we should cap to 100 winners per month to keep shipping simple. Who owns the fulfillment list? We can use our vendor (BrightShip) — they need CSV with name/address and a dispatch date.

jen (Finance): Budget check — estimate $6/card digital + $18 physical including swag and shipping. If we do 100 physicals, that's ~$2.4k/mo. Approve if People Ops confirms cadence and ROI tracking.

maria (People Ops): Thanks — cadence proposal: weekly digital pushes, monthly physical batch for top 10 nominated. Tracking: recognition-bot should emit a webhook for each e-card sent + a CSV export for top recipients.

sam (Eng): recognition-bot can emit events. Can we add a custom field "reason" so we can later query sentiment? e.g., "helped unblock release" or "shipped feature".

maria (People Ops): Yes — include a short free-text "reason" and an optional emoji tag. We'll add a prompt: "What's the impact? (1-3 short words)"

alex (Design): Asset naming: `spark_email_v1.png`, `spark_gif_v1.gif`. I'll drop a small README in Figma with usage rules and alt-text.

chris (Logistics): To confirm vendor timeline: need final CSV by the 20th for monthly batch. If we start next Wed, first physical fulfillment will be end-of-month.

jen (Finance): OK budget-wise for pilot (1 month). Please tag me on the post-mortem for actual spend vs estimate.

maria (People Ops): Action items: Alex — final assets by EOD. Sam / recognition-bot — webhook + CSV export with fields (name,email,reason,timestamp). Chris — confirm BrightShip rate and shipping cutoff. Jen — provisional approved for pilot. I'll draft the announcement copy and schedule the launch.

recognition-bot: scheduled reminder set: "Export top recipients CSV" on the 25th of each month. :robot_face:

sam (Eng): I'll scope the webhook this afternoon, pinging @maria when ready.

maria (People Ops): Great — thanks team. Will post final timeline once assets + webhook confirmed. :sparkles:
